lines.en: I have a meeting with my manager at ten.
She works as a nurse in a big hospital.
He got a promotion last week.
I usually finish work at five o'clock.
We are very busy at the office these days.
Can you send me the report by email?
My colleague helped me with the project.
I am looking for a new job these days.
The salary is good, but the hours are long.
I want to improve my skills this year.
